reasoning_content:
The .env APP_URL is localhost:8000 but assets reference 127.0.0.1:5173. That's because Vite dev server host likely configured. Fine.

Let's fetch the vite assets.

action.command: cd /workspace && for u in "@vite/client" "resources/js/app.ts" "resources/js/pages/MainPage.vue"; do echo -n "$u => "; curl -s -o /tmp/a.out -w "HTTP %{http_code} size=%{size_download}\n" "http://127.0.0.1:5173/$u"; done; echo "=== app.ts head ==="; head -c 400 /tmp/a.out
